# Nurlan Qadirov

> Frontend & Full-Stack developer based in Baku, Azerbaijan. Builds fast, secure
> e-commerce and corporate websites with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
> and Node.js. Available for freelance and contract work, remote or on-site.
> Works in Azerbaijani, English and Russian.

- E-commerce development (catalogue, filtering, cart, payment integration)

- Landing page development (conversion-focused, campaign-ready)

## Selected work

Live sites built by Nurlan Qadirov. Each one has a detailed case study on this
site describing the problem, the features and the technical decisions behind it.

- Harmal (https://harmal.az/) — luxury handmade jewellery and silk kəlağayı
  e-commerce. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. Trilingual (AZ/EN/RU),
  collection showcase and editorial journal.
  Case study: /en/projects/harmal
- Aristocrat Social & Business Club (https://aristocratnetworking.club/) —
  invitation-only B2B membership site. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
  Multi-step application form and 2026 events calendar.
  Case study: /en/projects/aristocrat
- Telco Group (https://telco-rouge.vercel.app/) — corporate site for an IT
  infrastructure, cybersecurity and cloud company in Baku. Next.js, TypeScript,
  Tailwind CSS. Live system-status panel and 25+ systems in four solution groups.
  Case study: /en/projects/telco-group
- RentCar Baku (https://rent-car-demo.vercel.app/az) — luxury car rental
  platform. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS. Trilingual routing, filtering by
  brand/class/budget, fleet catalogue with specs, blog, WhatsApp booking flow.
  Self-initiated demo, production-ready.
  Case study: /en/projects/rentcar-baku
- Cyber Mine (https://ciso.az/) — corporate site for a cybersecurity and IT
  consulting firm. React, Vite, Tailwind CSS. Four service tracks, staged
  delivery process, trust signals.
  Case study: /en/projects/cyber-mine
- Reform / MyData (https://mydata.az/) — corporate site for a digital
  transformation company. React, Vite, Tailwind CSS. Software development,
  Cisco network infrastructure, cybersecurity and IT consulting tracks.
  Case study: /en/projects/reform-mydata
- ZM Tech (https://zmtech.cloud/) — corporate site for an IT services company.
  React, Vite, Tailwind CSS. Web development, cybersecurity, 1C optimisation and
  hosting presented in a tabbed panel.
  Case study: /en/projects/zm-tech
- E-Partners (https://e-partners.az/) — single-page presentation site for a 360°
  business consultancy covering finance, marketing, legal, HR, IT, procurement
  and training. Hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no framework.
  Case study: /en/projects/e-partners
- Dəniz Restaurant QR Menu (https://deniz-qr-menu.vercel.app/menu) — trilingual
  digital QR menu for a restaurant in Baku. React, Vite, Tailwind CSS.
  14 categories, mobile-first, built for weak restaurant Wi-Fi.
  Case study: /en/projects/deniz-qr-menu
- El Travel — website for a travel agency in Baku. React, Framer. International,
  domestic and hunting tours split across three navigation families, plus gallery
  and team sections. The client's domain is no longer registered, so there is no
  live URL; the case study is written from the project archive.
  Case study: /en/projects/el-travel
